51361904.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to SMYD2 (unknown origin) by ITC assay

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: ITC. ITC experiments were conducted using a Microcal ITC200 at 23 °C in 25 mM Tris (pH 8.5), 50 mM NaCl, and 2% DMSO. Approximately 300 μL of a 15 μM SMYD2 protein solution was loaded into the sample cell, and a 200 μM compound solubilized in DMSO was loaded into the injection syringe. Then eight 4 μL injections of compound were sequentially added to the sample cell, producing a final compound-to-protein molar ratio of approximately 1.4:1. Thermodynamic parameters N (stoichiometric constant), K_a (association constant), and ΔH° (enthalpic change) were obtained by nonlinear least-squares fitting using Origin software.
original_paragraph.Figure 3 caption: Figure 3. ITC titration of compound 5: 34 μM SMYD2 protein solution and 400 μM compound 5 were used; K_d of 1.73 μM, ΔH° = −6.90 kcal/mol, TΔS° = 3.14 kcal/mol, and N = 0.92.
